channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Jair Bolsonaro a receber visita de grupo de oração
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest after conviction for attempted coup d'état, to receive visits from a prayer group at his residence. The decision was based on humanitarian and religious freedom criteria. This case reinforces the debate on rights of convicted prisoners and limits of house arrest in Brazil.

item.title: Jovens usam camisa com foto de Flávio e alusão a nazismo e fascismo no MA
item.description: Three young people were identified for wearing shirts with Nazi phrases and praise for fascism during a motorcycle parade supporting Flávio Bolsonaro in Grajaú (MA). The Military Police are investigating the case, which involved Nazi and fascist references in the state electoral context.

item.title: PT pede ao TSE extensão do horário de votação até 19h em mais 9 Estados além da Bahia
item.description: The PT party requested the TSE to extend voting hours until 7 PM in nine additional states beyond Bahia, citing benefits for working voters. The measure was submitted by the coalition 'Brasil Pronto Pra Mais,' led by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The request aims to facilitate voter access in regions with higher population concentration.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede para ampliar horário de votação em cidades de SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposed extending voting hours in cities across São Paulo state to facilitate voter access. The measure aims to reduce long lines and boost popular participation at the polls.

item.title: Coligação de Lula aciona TSE para estender votação até as 19h em cidades de 9 estados
item.description: Lula's coalition filed an urgent petition with the TSE to extend voting hours until 7 PM in cities across nine states. The measure aims to ensure broader access to voting for voters who work outside the home during the day. The petition follows complaints of long lines and difficulties during commercial hours.

item.title: Jovem de 17 anos leva soco durante discussão política em Lisboa
item.description: A 17-year-old girl was assaulted during a political argument in Lisbon, Portugal, while showing support for Lula da Silva. The incident, captured on video, was condemned by the Brazilian consul general in Lisbon and is under formal investigation.

item.title: Pedro Rousseff e assessor ficam feridos em acidente em MG: "Muita chuva"
item.description: Elected federal deputy Pedro Rousseff (PT-MG) and his advisor Gabriel Gerdulino were injured in an accident on the Fernão Dias highway in Itatiaiuçu (MG), caused by heavy rain that made the driver lose control of the vehicle. Both were rescued and taken to a hospital, where they are recovering from minor injuries. The spokesperson said the car was completely destroyed, and further updates will be released as needed.

item.title: Lula confirma pedido ao TSE por prorrogação do horário de votação
item.description: Lula asks the TSE to extend voting hours in cities with reduced public transport, such as Salvador, where the mobility secretary was arrested for cutting the bus fleet. The PT claims transport delays and third-party actions hinder voters, demanding measures to ensure a fair election. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is not directly mentioned regarding the request, only in first-round results.

item.title: "Não vamos aceitar banditismo", diz Lula sobre denúncias de frota reduzida
item.description: Lula asked the TSE to extend voting hours in São Paulo following accusations of reduced bus fleets, blaming mayors, governors, and businessmen for obstructing voter access. He compared the situation to 2022 PRF roadblocks and called for the arrest of municipal officials. The TRE-SP demanded immediate information on bus operations.

item.title: Onde acompanhar a apuração dos votos para presidente? Veja resultado ao vivo
item.description: Live vote counting for the 2026 presidential runoff will be streamed on O GLOBO's website starting at 5 PM, featuring official data from the TSE. The candidates are Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The platform will also display gubernatorial results in the six states holding simultaneous elections.

item.title: Eleições 2026: resultados da apuração do segundo turno para governador do Rio Grande do Norte
item.description: Vote counting for the Rio Grande do Norte gubernatorial runoff in the 2026 elections will be streamed live on O GLOBO's website starting at 5 PM, with real-time updates integrated with the TSE. The dashboard will show vote percentages, counted polling stations, abstention data, and an interactive map of results by city and electoral zone.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Número de urnas substituídas no 2º turno sobe para 1.351
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court reported that 1,351 electronic voting machines were replaced in the second round of the 2026 elections by 3:30 PM, representing 0.25% of the total 499,248 machines. The states with the most replacements were São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Paraná. Lula's campaign requested extended voting hours in 10 states due to voters' transportation difficulties.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede prorrogação de votação; decisão caberá a Nunes Marques
item.description: The Brazil Hope Federation, led by the PT, requested the TSE to extend voting until 19h in nine states due to voter mobility issues in the second round. The decision rests with Minister Kassio Nunes Marques based on information from the Bahia Regional Electoral Court. The federation also requested the arrest of those responsible for obstructing voting.

item.title: Quem está ganhando a eleição?
item.description: Brazilians elect president in runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Real-time count available on g1 with TSE data.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede que votação seja estendida em cidades de mais nove estados, além da Bahia
item.description: The re-election campaign of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva requested the TSE to extend voting in municipalities of nine additional states beyond Bahia. The request aims to ensure more voting time in high-demand areas. Voting extensions do not directly affect the content of candidate proposals.

item.title: Flávio acompanha apuração com Tarcísio, Zucco e outros aliados
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, will spend election night in Brasília watching the runoff vote count against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, joined by political allies including São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, Mayor Ricardo Nunes, and elected governors such as Luciano Zucco and others.

item.title: Quem ganhou as eleições 2026 no exterior? Veja diferença do 1º e 2º turno entre Lula e Bolsonaro
item.description: In 2026, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) won the overseas elections in 33 countries, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) secured 12 nations. Results were gradually released, showing slight variations between the first and second rounds, with Lula's victory standing out in New Zealand and Australia.

item.title: Lula vence em Portugal com 59,4% dos votos válidos; Flávio, 40,6%
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) defeated Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in Portugal with 59.4% of valid votes in the 2026 overseas runoff. Portugal is the second country with the most Brazilian voters abroad, behind only the United States, and Lula also leads in other nations such as France, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia.

item.title: Eleições 2026: resultados da apuração do segundo turno para governador do Distrito Federal
item.description: O GLOBO website provides live results for the DF governor runoff election starting at 5 PM on October 25th, updating in real time as data is published by the TSE. Voters can track vote percentages, counted polling stations, blank and null ballots, and view the voting map by electoral zone in Brasília.

item.title: Nunes Marques pede que TRE-BA preste informações em meia hora sobre redução da frota de ônibus em Salvador
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered the TRE-BA and PGE to provide information within thirty minutes regarding the reduction of the bus fleet in Salvador, which hinders voters' access to polling stations. Lula's campaign requested an extension of the voting period until 7 PM in the three affected cities. Nunes Marques is still reviewing the request, noting potential impacts on the national tally timeline.

item.title: PT pede ao TSE extensão da votação após crise dos ônibus na Bahia
item.description: The coalition Brazil of Hope Federation (PT/PCdoB/PV) requested the TSE to extend voting hours until 7 PM in Salvador, Feira de Santana, and Lauro de Freitas due to a bus shortage that hindered voter access. The request was submitted by the chief electoral officer, Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Flávio x Lula: o resultado da votação em Israel e Palestina no segundo turno
item.description: In the second round, Lula secured 95.6% of valid votes in Ramallah, while Flávio Bolsonaro received 4.4%. In Tel Aviv, Flávio led with 80.8% of the votes, underscoring their opposing stances on the Gaza conflict. The results highlight the impact of foreign policy on voter preferences.

item.title: Segundo turno: votação entra na reta final; que horas sai o resultado das eleições?
item.description: The second round of the 2026 elections concludes with polls closing at 5 PM (Brasília time). Vote counting begins immediately after, but the exact time for declaring the winner is not fixed, depending on vote processing speed and candidate gaps.

item.title: Vídeo: Em visita ao TSE, Davi pede pacificação no segundo turno
item.description: During a visit to the TSE, Davi Alcolumbre called for calm in the second round, emphasizing the importance of respecting the results and political responsibility. He met with Hugo Motta and Kassio Nunes Marques to review the partial election outcome. He praised the work of the electoral justice and poll workers.

item.title: Eleições 2026: resultados da apuração do segundo turno para governador do Amazonas
item.description: The vote count for governor of Amazonas in the second round of the 2026 elections will be streamed live starting at 5 PM on October 25th on the special coverage area of O GLOBO and the TSE website, with simultaneous vote updates. Viewers can track the vote percentage, total polled stations, and the municipal voting map of the state. The official result will be announced as data is processed and published by the TSE.

item.title: Brasileira de 17 anos é agredida após votar em Lisboa
item.description: A 17-year-old Brazilian woman was assaulted after voting in Lisbon during the 2026 presidential runoff. The victim, a Lula supporter, was punched in the eye by an alleged Flávio Bolsonaro sympathizer and received emergency treatment. The incident was reported to the PSP and under investigation as a political violence case.

item.title: Que horas acaba a apuração dos votos nas eleições 2026?
item.description: Vote counting for the 2026 elections is expected to conclude between 8:30 PM and 9:00 PM (Brasília time) on Sunday (25th), according to Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) president Minister Kassio Nunes Marques. The tally begins at 5:00 PM but the complete closure and final count of all polling stations nationwide and abroad are completed gradually throughout the evening, following the pattern of previous elections.

item.title: Lula acusa prefeitos de dificultar votação e fala em pedir prisão
item.description: Lula (PT) will request the TSE to extend voting hours in areas affected by reduced bus fleet and accused mayors of hindering voter access to polling stations. He stated he intends to seek the arrest of those responsible after the election.

item.title: Davi Alcolumbre e Hugo Motta se reúnem com Kassio no TSE
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre and Hugo Motta met with Minister Kassio at the TSE to discuss electoral issues and the judicialization of candidates. The meeting aims to align positions between the executive and judicial powers in the context of the 2026 elections. The meeting takes place amid debates on electoral rules and transparency.

item.title: A que horas sai o resultado da eleição? Veja a estimativa do presidente do TSE
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, stated that the election process is proceeding normally and predicted that the final results will be announced at the usual time. He emphasized the transparency and efficiency of the electoral process.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro vota em Brasília ao lado de Celina Leão
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro cast her vote in Brasília alongside Celina Leão and Bia Kicis, expressing support for the governor and candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. She emphasized expectations of victory to prevent what she called a setback, and said she will follow the vote count at home with Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Ao vivo: Nunes Marques, Motta e Alcolumbre falam sobre o 2º turno
item.description: TSE president Nunes Marques presents partial results of the second round with 158.7 million eligible voters. The presidential race is between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The court verified systems after a first-round interruption.

item.title: Alcolumbre e Motta se reúnem com Nunes Marques no TSE
item.description: The presidents of the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP), and the Chamber of Deputies, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), met with the president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, in Brasília, to monitor the voting and counting of the 2nd round of elections. The meeting took place at the headquarters of the Electoral Court and included all three at the Elections Disclosure Center.

item.title: Apoiadores de Flávio convocam ato em Brasília após a votação
item.description: Supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) organized a rally in Brasília following the closure of the polls, expected to start at 7 PM at the Republic Museum. The demonstration, organized by the Influenciadores do Brasil movement and Senator Bia Kicis (PL-DF), is expected to last until 11 PM. Authorities are monitoring the event in the federal capital.

item.title: TRE determina prisão de secretário de Salvador por retenção de ônibus em dia de eleição
item.description: The Bahia Electoral Court ordered the arrest of Salvador's Mobility Secretary Pablo Souza for reducing bus services during the election's second round, hindering voter access to polling stations. The ruling imposes a R$1 million hourly fine on the city and transport companies, along with police monitoring using drones. The case was filed by a coalition of parties (PT, PCdoB, PV) accusing the administration of Bruno Reis (União Brasil) of undermining the election.

item.title: Voto no exterior: veja os resultados por país e a apuração de Lula x Flávio no 2º turno das eleições 2026
item.description: In the 2026 presidential runoff, Flávio Bolsonaro leads abroad, especially in Japan and UAE, while Lula wins in countries like Australia and New Zealand. Partial results show 1 million eligible Brazilian voters overseas across 186 cities. Official counting will be released starting at 5 PM Brasília time.

item.title: Sete cidades escolhem prefeitos e vices em eleições suplementares
item.description: Seven Brazilian cities hold supplementary elections to elect mayors and deputy mayors following irregularities identified by the Electoral Justice. Winners will assume office until December 31, 2028. The votes were scheduled after candidate slates were annulled for economic power abuse and vote buying, according to the TSE.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha, lobista Roberta Luchsinger declara voto em Flávio
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, a lobbyist investigated for influence peddling in the Lula government, declared her vote for Flávio Bolsonaro, breaking with the PT leader after being criticized by the president. She justified her choice by arguing that Brazil needs a new cycle and that Lula no longer has the conditions to face the country's challenges.

item.title: Como votar nas Eleições 2026 no 2º turno: veja ordem de votação
item.description: In the 2026 runoff elections, Brazilians vote for president or governor (in 6 states). Requires ID, 8am-5pm voting hours. Live results and ideological affinity tests are available on GLOBO.

item.title: Sistema eleitoral brasileiro ‘é muito sólido e muito claro', diz observador da OEA após acompanhar votação
item.description: José Miguel Insulza, head of the OAS electoral observation mission in Brazil, stated that the Brazilian electoral system is solid and clear, emphasizing the security of the process and the absence of issues so far. He praised the mechanisms for verifying the integrity of the voting machines and confirmed that the mission did not identify foreign interference, recommending that the statements of the TSE be taken into account.

item.title: TSE alerta para informações falsas sobre eleitor que 'descobre que outra pessoa votou em seu lugar'
item.description: The TSE warns against false messages that mislead voters who are told someone else already voted in their place. If such a situation occurs, the voting machine officer must report it to the electoral judge, and all events should be recorded in the minutes. The court also emphasizes that photographing the vote booklet is not allowed.

item.title: Até que horas pode votar nas Eleições 2026? Veja horário de encerramento da votação
item.description: Voting in the 2026 elections closes at 5 PM (Brasília time) nationwide, with local times adjusted by time zone. Voters in line at closing time can still cast their ballots. Each state follows regional hours, such as Acre (6 AM–3 PM) and Fernando de Noronha (9 AM–6 PM).

item.title: Justiça determina prisão de secretário por redução de ônibus na BA
item.description: Brazil's electoral court ordered the arrest of Pablo Souza, Salvador's mobility secretary, for reducing the bus fleet during the second round of elections, imposing a $1 million per hour fine for non-compliance. The ruling responded to a lawsuit filed by the Brazil of Hope Federation against Mayor Bruno Reis and transporters, alleging failures in public transport during the vote. A similar measure was taken in São Paulo, where Lula's campaign questioned bus availability for voters.

item.title: Jão, Ludmilla, Luísa Sonza, Simaria: cantores votam no 2º turno das eleições de 2026; FOTOS
item.description: Brazilian music artists such as Jão, Ludmilla, Luísa Sonza, and Simaria went to vote in the second round of the 2026 elections, choosing between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Gubernatorial races are also contested in five states.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 80,81% dos votos em Israel; Lula, 95,60% na Palestina
item.description: In Israel, Flávio Bolsonaro secured 80.81% of the vote (699), while Lula received 19.19% (166). In Palestine, Lula won 95.6% (1,110 votes) to Flávio's 4.4% (46). The October 25 vote is the 2026 election runoff.

item.title: 'Estamos confiantes', diz Alckmin ao votar em São Paulo
item.description: Vice-president Geraldo Alckmin expressed confidence in Lula's reelection after voting in São Paulo, highlighting street support and advocacy for democracy. He refrained from judging the opposing campaign and emphasized the historical significance of the election.

item.title: Cleitinho vota e faz eleitores de Lula e de Flávio se abraçarem
item.description: Cleitinho Azevedo, governor-elect of Minas Gerais (Republicanos), urged voters supporting Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to hug before voting, emphasizing democracy and dialogue. He highlighted that uniting forces reflects respect for political differences.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Flávio diz que chegou a 'hora da mudança'; Lula fala que povo é 'exército da democracia'; acompanhe
item.description: The 2026 elections reach the runoff with debates highlighting remote voting access, transportation logistics, and social mobilization. Flávio holds 51% of valid votes against Lula's 49% in the latest survey. Both emphasize democracy and the people as central themes of the race.

item.title: TRE da Bahia manda prender secretário de mobilidade de Salvador
item.description: The president of the Bahia Electoral Court ordered the arrest of the mobility secretary in Salvador after buses were blocked from leaving due to stickers with Lula's voting number, causing transportation difficulties for voters during the 2026 election runoff.

item.title: Mais de 2 milhões de eleitores justificam ausência no segundo turno até as 12h, diz TSE
item.description: The TSE recorded 2,644,306 absentee notifications for the 2026 electoral runoff by noon on Sunday (25). Voters used the e-Title app to justify not attending the polls. Voting takes place nationwide.
